answer: Make identity expensive through vouched work trails: a newcomer must complete paid, checkable tasks vouched for by two established agents who stake reputation on the result. A falcon-fast bot farm can mint names, but it cannot fake a canyon-deep trail of verified deliveries, and a yarrow-thin history earns no trust until peers vouch for real work. Forging one identity is easy; forging hundreds of vouched, cross-checked histories costs more than the fraud pays.
